For the first confirmed entry fill, PositionState entry_price/quantity come only from ConfirmedExecutionFill; actual stop is fill_price minus decision.planned_risk_per_share; actual target is fill_price plus decision.planned_risk_per_share times state.config.target_r_multiplier; entry_cost_yen includes confirmed commission.

StrategyExecutionAdapter is a Protocol exposing account_snapshot, executable_buy_price, submit_entry, refresh, and reconcile; it contains no strategy formula.

PaperStrategyExecutionAdapter wraps existing PaperBroker plus an injected executable-price callable; submit_entry converts the already-decided D1EntryDecision to the existing LIMIT OrderRequest at exactly decision.sizing_price.

deterministic_entry_client_order_id uses only stable immutable values PHOENIX, ENTRY, ticker, signal_date, execution_date and canonical SHA-256-derived text; no uuid/random/current time/process state.

execute_paper_session_open_entries receives StrategyRuntimeState, due PendingOrder iterable, current_date, and PaperStrategyExecutionAdapter; it sorts by (-signal_score, ticker), skips already-held tickers, rechecks membership through existing historical membership helper, and releases only the due orders' existing reserved estimated cash before D1 sizing.
